members.mechanism: Macroeconomic announcement premium: the stock market earns a higher excess return on days with scheduled major macro announcements (FOMC, NFP, GDP first and last, ISM manufacturing, the earlier of CPI and PPI), a premium for bearing scheduled news risk (Ai, Bansal, Guo; Savor, Wilson).
members.condition: trade date d is in the EC-K9 announcement date set (60 dates in 2025-04-01..2026-06-19; 58 after the R-12 holiday-session exclusions)
members.decision_time_ct: known in advance from official schedules, fixed before the 17:59 CT entry intent on the evening before d; dates rescheduled by the Oct-Nov 2025 lapse are [unverified: date announced before the entry intent] (R-07); E.11 keeps such a date only if announced before the entry intent; E.12 harness uses the date set as known at the entry intent; no released value read
members.entry: BUY q_c by market intent on the 17:59 CT bar of the evening before the trade date, filling at the 18:00 CT open (Sunday 17:59 / 18:00 CT for a Monday trade date); D-entry amended for D9.4 (round 2 item 5); a user decision under R-06 (design draft K9-H; alternative: the 17:00 CT first bar)
members.exit: market intent on the first bar at or after C_X - 2 min (14:58 CT), fill at the 14:59 open (D-exit); announcement dates on an equity early close, early halt or closure are excluded (R-12, amending round 2 item 14); F governs any position open at an unscheduled halt
members.hold: about 20 h 59 min, 18:00 CT to 14:59 CT, inside one trade date; flat by F = 15:08 CT; the hold contains the release
data_items: EC-K9 date set from BLS, Federal Reserve, BEA and ISM official calendars (fetched; reports/stage_e10_research/catalog/)
vehicle ohlcv-1m open and instrument_id at 18:00 CT and 14:59 CT

excluded.reason: Excluded in round 2 (items 6-10). excluded.what: Pre-announcement overnight long (reopen to release - 5 min, NFP/ISM/GDP)
excluded.reason: Variant of K9-anncday-01: same mechanism, a subset of the same dates, the hold window as a parameter (no-grids rule). Further reason (R-02): its window is D.1's E-H1 window. Source statement (R-08, replacing "weak"): non-FOMC pre-announcement returns "stable and significant across all three subperiods", 6.98 bps and significant in 2012-2018 (P-K9C-006-e). For the user (R-08): (i) the variant's source (HPWZ, to May 2018) is not source-overlap, while K9-anncday-01 is; (ii) the post-announcement segment the member adds is "small and insignificant, while exhibiting large variances" (P-K9C-006-c). Offered as the alternative literal set; lead recommends the full-day member (K9-G).
